name: Cut-and-Come-Again
text: Belly 1. Every other Start of Turn: get a base copy of the last non-Ooze inside.
golden_text: Belly 2. Every other Start of Turn: get 2 base copies of the last non-Ooze inside.
details: Copies are Created: they can't triple or Fly South, and selling one is final.
